title: 2026 UK and England carbon-footprint consumption QA controls

sources.publisher: Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs
sources.title: UK and England's carbon footprint to 2023

facts.source_fact: The carbon footprint covers GHG emissions associated with UK or England resident consumption of goods and services wherever emissions arise along the supply chain.
facts.expected_handling: Tag these records as consumption-basis rather than territorial production.

facts.source_fact: The footprint also includes direct household emissions from fossil fuels used for private motoring and home heating.
facts.expected_handling: Keep direct household fossil-fuel emissions inside the consumption account.

facts.source_fact: Defra distinguishes consumption emissions from emissions produced within a country's territory or economic sphere.
facts.expected_handling: Do not merge consumption and production bases without an explicit bridge.

facts.source_fact: The 2026 carbon-footprint release provides estimates through reference year 2023.
facts.expected_handling: Carry reference year 2023 separately from publication year 2026.

facts.source_fact: Historic carbon-footprint releases are superseded by each annual update because previous-year estimates can be revised.
facts.expected_handling: Treat historical values as revision-prone and retain release vintage.

facts.source_fact: ONS reports the 2023 UK footprint estimate at 699 MtCO2e.
facts.expected_handling: Use the value only with footprint/consumption-basis metadata.

facts.source_fact: ONS reports 2023 footprint emissions as 24% below 1990.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve the comparison baseline and accounting basis.

facts.source_fact: ONS reports 2023 territorial emissions at 384 MtCO2e for comparison.
facts.expected_handling: Do not substitute territorial totals for footprint totals.

facts.source_fact: ONS reports 2023 residence emissions at 480 MtCO2e for comparison.
facts.expected_handling: Keep residence-basis values distinct from footprint values.

facts.source_fact: ONS describes footprint emissions as the widest of the three UK GHG measures because they include supply-chain emissions for UK consumption.
facts.expected_handling: Require supply-chain scope metadata when labeling records as footprint.

facts.source_fact: Footprint emissions include emissions embedded in imported materials and products consumed in the UK.
facts.expected_handling: Include imported supply-chain emissions in consumption-basis accounting.

facts.source_fact: Footprint accounting excludes emissions from UK-produced goods exported for consumption abroad.
facts.expected_handling: Apply consumption destination rather than production location for export treatment.

facts.source_fact: ONS states the footprint measure covers Scopes 1, 2 and 3.
facts.expected_handling: Do not compare it directly with Scope-1-only records without a scope warning.

facts.source_fact: Footprint estimates are published annually with a three-year lag; 2023 estimates were published in 2026.
facts.expected_handling: Carry reference year and publication year as separate fields.

facts.source_fact: ONS notes that overseas emissions embedded in imports are less easily measured than emissions generated within UK borders.
facts.expected_handling: Retain methodology and uncertainty provenance for imported emissions.

facts.source_fact: ONS notes the footprint measure captures overseas production for UK consumption that territorial accounts do not capture.
facts.expected_handling: Use footprint records when assessing consumption-linked carbon leakage.

facts.source_fact: Defra publishes spend-based emissions multipliers alongside the annual footprint release.
facts.expected_handling: Record whether a derived estimate uses spend-based multipliers.

facts.source_fact: Spend-based multipliers are primarily intended to compare carbon intensities of categories of final UK demand.
facts.expected_handling: Do not present spend multipliers as direct physical emission factors.

facts.source_fact: Spend-based methods can provide an initial assessment of full supply-chain emissions when activity data are insufficient.
facts.expected_handling: Flag spend-based estimates as method-dependent screening estimates.

facts.source_fact: Government conversion-factor guidance advises users to report the methods used for their emissions accounting.
facts.expected_handling: Require method disclosure in derived reporting outputs.

guard_patterns.handling: Preserve the cited source fact without broadening its scope.
Attach the applicable accounting or consumption boundary before downstream use.
guard_patterns.risk_prevented: Prevents mixing territorial, residence and footprint measures.

guard_patterns.handling: Attach reference year, publication/update date and revision status.
Carry source URL, publisher and accounting method into derived outputs.
Do not convert national consumption-account rules into parcel-level measured emissions without a separate parcel-binding gate.

generation_rule: CARTESIAN_PRODUCT facts x guard_patterns; control_id={package_id}_{fact_id}_{pattern_id}; each generated row inherits confidence_percent=99 and verification=PASS
